# Krishna Chaitanya

## Who I Am
Krishna Chaitanya is an AI Product Manager with 5+ years of experience building 0→1 products across B2B and B2C. Based in Hyderabad, India. Currently at Nielsen Media leading Digital Content Rating products across 6 countries. Previously led HRTech SaaS at Altimetrik and co-founded a short-video startup (10K+ downloads, 2K DAU in 12 days).

## What I Do
- 0→1 Product Building
- AI Agents & Automation
- Product Strategy & Roadmapping
- GTM & Experimentation

## What I've Built
- Fumble Machine — A viral financial regret engine that calculates opportunity cost of purchases against the stock market. Generates shareable Loss Receipts.
- ProdReady — Automated quality gate for AI-generated code. Detects secret leaks and SEO gaps that LLMs miss.
- SkillTree — AI agent that turns vague learning goals into structured curricula with resources and quizzes.

## Currently
Learning LangGraph and building AI Agents to reduce operational noise, improve decisions, and unlock new product experiences.
